description: This file defines the BasicSearchEngine class within the SuiteCRM project, responsible for executing search operations across multiple modules, generating search queries, and returning structured search results. It includes functions for initiating searches, querying modules, constructing where clauses, and preparing list view data.
published: SuiteCRM	extbackslash Search	extbackslash	extbackslash BasicSearchEngine

classes.name: BasicSearchEngine
classes.description: A class extending SearchEngine that handles executing search queries across modules, aggregating results, and interfacing with list view definitions and search forms.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Executes a search query using provided SearchQuery object, measures execution time, and returns SearchResults.

methods.name: searchModules
methods.description: Performs module-specific searches by constructing where clauses using search forms, list view definitions, and unified search fields, then compiles results and counts.

methods.name: buildFilterFields
methods.description: Builds an array of filterable fields for list views, excluding relationship and hidden fields.
